sentences.text: Gnathomortis was a large, extinct marine lizard belonging to the mosasaur family, reaching a total length of 10.5 meters.
Fossils were recovered from the Early Campanian Mancos Shale in Colorado. The species was originally named Prognathodon stadtmani in 1999 before Lively coined the new genus name Gnathomortis in 2020.
It is classified in the class Sauropsida, order Squamata, superfamilia Mosasauroidea, and family Mosasauridae.
This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous in what is now North America, specifically between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
A 2006 phylogenetic analysis suggested that Prognathodon stadtmani did not fit within the Prognathodon clade, leading to its reclassification.
